title: Kissed Crispy Peruvian Haddock Chupe De Camarones
description: A winey and crispy Peruvian dish featuring smoked haddock in a mother-sauce-base, high in protein and perfect for a monsoon evening
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
Season the smoked haddock fillets with salt and pepper
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat and sear the haddock fillets until crispy
Remove the haddock from the skillet and set aside
In the same skillet, add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant
Add the chopped onion and diced ají amarillo peppers to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent
Add the white wine to the skillet and cook until the liquid is almost completely reduced
Add the fish stock to the skillet and bring to a boil
Reduce the heat to low and stir in the heavy cream
Return the haddock fillets to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top of each fillet
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 10 minutes
